findings.evidence: `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:2937` falls back to `b.is.TableInfoByName(name.DBName, name.TblName)` when `resolveCtx.GetTableName(field)` is nil (view query not preprocessed). But `name.TblName` is overwritten to the table alias for any `... FROM tbl AS alias` (`pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:462`). The real table name is kept in `name.OrigTblName` (`pkg/types/field_name.go:26`). Result: for views whose inner SELECT uses table aliases, the infoschema lookup uses the alias (not a real table) -> returns error -> `tblInfoFromCol` returns nil -> `checkOnlyFullGroupBy` continues and can miss the 1055 error. Later-history check: upstream still has the same logic (`git show upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` at `tblInfoFromCol` around line 3131).
findings.fix: In the view fallback path, look up by original table name: `b.is.TableInfoByName(name.DBName, name.OrigTblName)` (and optionally fallback to `name.TblName` only when `OrigTblName` is empty).
findings.impact: `ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY` can still be bypassed when selecting from VIEWs whose definition uses table aliases (common in join-heavy views), leading to MySQL-incompatible acceptance of nondeterministic grouped queries under a mode intended to reject them.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed as of `upstream/master`: `tblInfoFromCol` still calls `TableInfoByName(name.DBName, name.TblName)` in the nil-`tnW` path.
findings.verify: Add a regression test variant like: `create view v as select * from t as tt group by null;` then under default sql_mode (ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY on) `select * from v` must raise 1055; under `set @@sql_mode=''` it must succeed. Consider a join view where every base table is aliased to ensure coverage.
findings.what: `ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY` fix is incomplete for VIEWs with table aliases: infoschema fallback uses `FieldName.TblName` (alias) instead of `OrigTblName`, so aliased tables inside views can still evade the check.

subject: planner: ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY sql_mode was not working with VIEWs (#57473)
summary: The commit fixes ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY enforcement for simple views by adding an infoschema fallback when view subqueries lack resolveCtx preprocessing, but the fallback uses `FieldName.TblName` and can still miss errors for views whose inner query uses table aliases; this remains unfixed on upstream/master.
